declare
  s varchar2(32767);
  n number;
begin
  s := 'select /* mtk_nasty_long_dynamic */ count(*) from mtk_cust where id in (';
  for i in 1 .. 999 loop
    s := s || i || ',';
  end loop;
  s := s || '0) or id in (';
  for i in 1000 .. 1998 loop
    s := s || i || ',';
  end loop;
  s := s || '0)';
  execute immediate s into n;
  -- SQL*Plus strips CR from script lines, so build a statement whose text really contains CR LF
  execute immediate 'select /* mtk_nasty_crlf */ ''crlf via dynamic sql line1' || chr(13) || chr(10) ||
                    'EXEC #1:c=0 line2' || chr(13) || chr(10) || 'line3'' as crlf_literal from dual' into s;

  execute immediate 'select /* mtk_nasty_ctl */' || chr(12) || chr(11) || ' count(*) from dual' into n;
end;
